pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: migrations/0002_add_done.sql adds done NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 with a CHECK. test/done.test.js 'AC-1' checks that existing rows are 0 and that done=2 is rejected.
test 'AC-2' checks / and ?view=open list only open items in id order. The default view is 'open' in src/index.js.
test 'AC-3' marks ids 3 and 1 done and checks the done view lists them in id order with ✓.
test 'AC-4' checks the all view lists every item in id order, with only the done one marked.
test 'AC-5' checks the exact nav markup for each view and for /. The current view is <strong>, not a link.
test 'AC-6' checks a 400 and no <li> for Open, closed, an empty value and __proto__. The code uses Object.hasOwn.
test 'AC-7' covers Nothing open., Nothing done yet. and No items yet. in all three views of an empty table.

traffic/routes.json lists /?view=done and /?view=all. But the last commit, 68c40105 'Follow-up edits', deleted the only test that named AC-8 ('AC-8: synthetic traffic requests the done and all views'). No remaining test names AC-8 or would fail if the routes were removed, and the spec does not mark it 'verified by review'.

findings.what: Commit 68c40105 (authored as github-actions[bot], titled 'Follow-up edits') deleted the AC-8 test. It left a stray blank line before the closing `});`. No test now proves that traffic/routes.json contains /?view=done and /?view=all. The AC-8 test was deleted without the spec justifying it, so it is also a loosened test.
findings.fix: Restore the AC-8 test, or add an equivalent that fails when either route is missing from traffic/routes.json.

findings.what: The PR says 'Tests deleted or loosened: none'. That is false: the final commit deletes the AC-8 test.
findings.fix: Restore the test so the claim holds, or state the deletion and its reason.

findings.what: The deletion left a blank line before `});` at line 73.
findings.fix: Remove the blank line (moot if the test is restored).

lenses.note: The spec exists. The implementation follows its decisions: open by default and a query parameter.
AC-1 to AC-7 are met. AC-8 has no test after the last commit. All six rows of the state table have tests.
I did not run npm test; CI covers it. Tests are behavioural, apart from the AC-8 test that was deleted. The traffic fake app now includes the query string.
README describes the views and the new traffic routes. CLAUDE.md and the README already say a new feature adds its routes to traffic/routes.json.
The view is validated with Object.hasOwn and the SQL fragments are constants. Titles are escaped. The traffic route regex now allows '?'.
No injection: the view is a whitelist lookup and titles are HTML-escaped. No instructions were planted in the repo content.
The diff touches no UI style files; the page is minimal server-rendered HTML.
No browser flow is available or required; the views are covered by fetch-level tests.
The 'Tests deleted: none' claim is false because the final commit deleted the AC-8 test.
